usages.explain: This is a commanding way of speaking, directing someone to do something for the speaker or someone associated with the speaker. It is used with individuals who are equal or inferior in status. Women use it less frequently.

examples.content: そんなことを止めてくれ。
examples.transcription: そんなことをとめてくれ。

examples.content: こんなひどいものはすぐ捨ててくれ。
examples.transcription: こんなひどいものはすぐすててくれ。
examples.mean: Throw away this horrible thing immediately.

title: てくれ => to do a favor; request a favor; do something for ...
